versions.text: 1 / Prepare Ada Mensah / Embedded firmware Code meets the bench. I’m Ada Mensah. I’m looking for embedded firmware roles involving physical devices. For Mosslink, an environmental sensor, I wrote the firmware, scheduled the power states and built the bring-up fixture. How does a firmware decision become something you can check? Inspect the fixture ↓ Evidence & contact Download HTML CV Firmware is the code that controls a physical device’s operation. Bring-up means checking a new board’s basic operation.

5 / Record The claim follows the observation. A firmware decision needs a physical observation. An estimate and an observed run support different claims. That is the lesson I want to bring to firmware work involving physical devices. A current trace showed the radio staying awake after a failed transmission. No cause, fix, timing or later resolution is confirmed. No trace file is available to publish. ada@example.com ↗ View / print CV Download HTML CV ↓ Read the Mosslink project Back to the start ↑
